usedFor: Shopify holds the products and orders, and Pencil Spaces receives a collaborative space through “Create Space”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Space” in Pencil Spaces
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own collaborative space, with hosts and participants invited by the action.

watchOut: “Create Space” invites the listed hosts and participants, so the invite list must be right before it runs.
